content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0), with R00.2 and R42 also documented. The monitoring was indicated to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of this service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
